items.title: LIVE | Metal, Real Estate & Capital Market Stocks Lead rally | Closing Bell
items.description: The Nifty gains close to 100 points and reclaims the 24,400 mark, while the Sensex jumps over 250 points. Brent crude falls below $100 a barrel for the sixth straight session, with easing oil prices aiding the market rally. The Nifty Bank gains half a percent, while the Midcap index surges nearly 400 points. Metal stocks lead the gains, with the Nifty Metal index rising over 2%, followed by realty stocks. PSU Bank and FMCG indices add 1% each, while IT stocks remain under pressure and the Nifty IT index slips again. Tata Steel and JSW Steel drive the metal rally, while Bajaj Finance features among the top gainers. Overall, metal, realty and capital market stocks lead the market rally.

items.title: Yields, Earnings and the AI debate - JPM's Sanjay Mookim on what next for Indian stocks
items.description: Sanjay Mookim, Head of Equity Research for India at J.P. Morgan, joins from the J.P. Morgan Global India Investor Conference to discuss whether global sentiment on India is turning, why FPI flows have stayed away despite strong domestic earnings, and what 5% US yields mean for Indian equity valuations. He explains why he still favours large-cap value — especially financials — over the momentum-driven mid-cap rally, flags manufacturing as a structural bright spot on tariffs and currency tailwinds, and weighs in on the IPO supply surge and IT as a possible value trap. His message for investors heading into festive season: be patient, don't be greedy.
